title: BedBoom
description: This plugin makes that beds blow up every time you click it. Even in the overworld!
body:
BedBoom is a lightweight, high-performance plugin for Paper servers that brings the explosive power of the Nether and End right into the Overworld! With this plugin, players can now use beds as devastating explosives in any dimension. Written entirely in Kotlin, BedBoom is optimized for speed and efficiency, ensuring zero lag while adding a chaotic new twist to your server's gameplay.
